title: 3 Masterpiece Anime of 2026 That Are Written by Women
content: The Summer 2026 anime season has almost ended, and Fall is here, which means there are already nine months to look back on this year and see what it has produced in the anime industry.
author: ComicBook

title: Amata Games' Shinjuku Anomaly Game Reveals September 30 Launch in Trailer
content: Amata Games revealed on Monday that its Shinjuku Anomaly horror visual novel game will launch for PC via Steam on September 30. The company streamed a trailer: You have taken on a part-time job photographing anomalies that lurk in Shinjuku at night.
author: ANN

title: South Park Brings Back Butters With New Season 29 Episode First Look Trailer – Watch Now
content: South Park is coming back this week with a brand new episode, and the first look at Season 29’s next new entry is putting Butters back front and center. South Park Season 29 kicked off its run this Fall with a major change to its title.
author: ComicBook

title: Smile Up President Noriyuki Higashiyama Steps Down
content: Amidst the changes, Smile Up will continue to be responsible for handling the compensation measures for sexual abuse victims of the agency's late founder Johnny Kitagawa , a process that started in November 2023. The company will shut down after the compensation measures are completed.
author: ANN

title: Cells at Work! Gets Dental Spinoff Manga
content: The November issue of Kodansha 's Shonen Sirius magazine announced on Friday that Akane Shimizu 's Cells at Work! manga will get a new spinoff manga by Koma Warita and Kawede Sakaki titled Hataraku Saibō Dental ( Cells at Work! Dental) in the next issue on October 26.
author: ANN

title: Captain Tsubasa: Rising Sun Finals Manga Resumes Serialization in October
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Yōichi Takahashi 's Captain Tsubasa franchise announced on Monday that the Captain Tsubasa: Rising Sun Finals manga will resume serialization on October 6, with new chapters on Tuesdays. The series entered a hiatus after its 100th chapter in May.
author: ANN

title: The Apothecary Diaries Competitor Drops New Look Ahead of 2027 Return
content: Now that the Fall 2026 anime season is almost here, fans are already bidding farewell to most of their beloved Summer 2026 shows. However, the Fall 2026 season is going to be the biggest quarter of the year, with several major sequels, including The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 .
author: ComicBook

title: LEGO Leak Reveals First Look at Upcoming Dragon Ball Set
content: A new leak has revealed the first glimpse at LEGO’s upcoming Dragon Ball lineup of products. After months of rumors, LE G O confirmed earlier this month in a short teaser trailer that it would soon be collaborating with the storied anime series.
author: ComicBook

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 Confirms Next Major Update Is Coming Soon
content: Jujutsu Kaisen is now hard at work on the anime’s return for its fourth season, and has thankfully confirmed that the next major update for the new episodes is coming our way soon.
author: ComicBook

title: Black Clover Season 2 Reveals New Pre-Premiere Visual Ahead of October 3 Return
content: Black Clover Season 2 anime has revealed a new pre-premiere visual ahead of its October 3, 2026 premiere. Episode 1 is titled “War Begins,” with the synopsis and preview images available.
author: Anime Corner
